content:

Acked-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>

 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

index a3a4289f713e..58b9c6463364 100644

+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/sound/qcom,sm8250.yaml
@@ -23,6 +23,8 @@ properties:
       - qcom,sdm845-sndcard
       - qcom,sm8250-sndcard
